H_hierarchical.evidence: The paper gives a flat PLC mapping from moisture sensor inputs to motor/master/zonal valve outputs, with no parent modes, substates, or composite-state structure.

G_guards_arith.evidence: The controller uses threshold guards '22 to Turn ON and 55 to Turn OFF' and includes a multi-input guard: 'When all moisture sensors are initiated all zonal and master valves gets open.'

A_actions_nontrivial.evidence: Actions are concrete actuator commands: the PLC controls 'opening and closing of the master valve and zonal valve' and the 'ON and OFF position of the water pump automatically.'

F_fault_recovery.evidence: No emergency stop, safe state, rollback, abort, alarm, or recovery behavior is described in the paper.

T1_cross_section_element.evidence: The core threshold, I/O coil table, and valve-opening conditions are all located in the Results and Discussion / Circuit Diagram portion, not split across distant sections.

T2_implicit_domain_term.evidence: Terms such as moisture sensor, master valve, zonal valve, and pump are mostly used as concrete I/O elements; the needed rules are directly stated rather than hidden in domain terminology.

T3_implicit_action_from_prose.evidence: The pump action is described generally in prose as automatic ON/OFF control, while the numbered condition list mainly states valve openings, so the modeler must attribute pump behavior back to irrigation states.

T4_multivar_arith_guard.evidence: The full-demand case depends on the conjunction of all four moisture sensors being initiated.

T5_composite_internal_behavior.evidence: There is no composite parent state and therefore no parent entry/during/exit behavior.

T6_global_cross_cutting_recovery.evidence: The paper does not define any from-any-state fault or recovery transition.

C1_speculative_dfs.evidence: No composite states or init/pseudo-state chains are present.

C2_expr_ir_smt.evidence: There is one meaningful boolean-composed guard over all moisture sensors, plus simple moisture thresholds, but not three or more arithmetic/boolean guard formulas.

C3_forced_and_aspect.evidence: No cross-cutting transition from multiple substates and no parent-level during monitor is declared.

C4_abstract_action.evidence: Outputs are concrete actuator commands to motor, master valve, and zonal valves, not abstract logging, publishing, or notification effects.

key_nl_quotes: I have set the value of moisture sensor manually as 22 to Turn ON and 55 to Turn OFF.
When all moisture sensors are initiated all zonal and master valves gets open.
one_line_pitch: A flat but useful irrigation EFSM stress case where threshold guards and multi-sensor valve/pump action attribution challenge guard and action extraction despite lacking hierarchy or fault recovery.
rationale: The sample has meaningful guard and action content: moisture thresholds, per-zone sensor rules, shared master-valve activation, and an all-sensors condition. It is weaker as a top stress test because it has no hierarchy, no fault/recovery behavior, and only concrete actuator actions. Its main baseline traps are pump-action attribution from prose and the multi-variable all-sensor guard, making it suitable as a backup rather than a top candidate.
